channel.title: PkgWatch: suspicious packages on npm and PyPI
channel.description: PkgWatch statically analyses newly published npm and PyPI packages and lists the ones that look suspicious. Entries are leads for human review, not verdicts.

item.title: [MEDIUM 57] suspicious pypi package: xtim 4.2.1
item.description:
Risk score 57/100 (medium).

  • setup.py subprocess.run() starts a process at install time.
  • Recently created package from a publisher with little history, with a name similar to popular package 'stim'.
  • Name is 1 edit(s) from popular package 'stim' (one character substituted).
